commentary: 18.4: Kohli pushes to mid-off for a single. RCB 178/4 chasing 195. Asking rate 11.33.
18.5: Short ball, DK slaps it to deep point for TWO. Excellent running between the wickets.
18.6: Full toss on leg — DK muscles it over cow corner for a massive SIX! 🔥 Chinnaswamy erupts!
19.1: Dot ball! Narine fires a carrom ball, DK misses. 9 needed off 5 balls. Pressure mounting.
19.2: WICKET! DK swings wildly and is clean bowled by Narine! The crowd goes deathly silent.
19.3: WICKET! Siraj run out going for an impossible second! Complete collapse. Fans are devastated.
19.4: Wide ball! A lifeline for RCB. 8 needed off 3 balls. Can they pull off a miracle?
19.5: Short outside off — swung HARD — SIX! Over deep square leg! The stadium ERUPTS! 2 off 1!
19.6: Full and outside off... edged... FOUR through third man! RCB WIN BY 2 WICKETS! SCENES! 🏆🎉
